filter.expression: attribute.audit.model_alias = 'premium' AND attribute.audit.deployment EXISTS AND attribute.audit.deployment NOT LIKE 'openai/%'

description: A call on the premium class was answered by another model within the last 15 minutes: the gateway's audit record names premium as its alias and a deployment that is not OpenAI's. LiteLLM falls back to big when OpenAI fails a premium call, its credits spent or the API down (k8s/platform/litellm/helmrelease.yaml), and the gateway runs a call on big when the premium month cap cannot fit it. Add OpenAI credits or raise budget.premium_month_eur. The label event marks the fallback as an event: factoryd closes no card when the alert clears.
